translations.web: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”
translations.bsb: so the Jews said to the man who had been healed, “This is the Sabbath! It is unlawful for you to carry your mat.”
translations.kjv: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.
translations.asv: So the Jews said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath, and it is not lawful for thee to take up thy bed.
